control: Remove only checked-Core lookup indices before each build, outside timed commands. Keep frontend, native object and sealed-image caches and every correctness check.
order: Control first on odd repetitions; reuse first on even repetitions, for each workload.
limitations: Synthetic modular scalar and record/generic call graphs; not a benchmark of arbitrary LLM-generated applications.
One development workstation; other repository validation briefly ran during this comparison. Raw host snapshots and all samples are retained.
Cold means fresh compiler cache and output; OS filesystem caches were not flushed.
Same-binary comparison isolates the checked-image shortcut, not historical compiler-release differences.
